text.jp:
……故郷の記憶が戻るかも。
そう考えて、挑んできたんだな。
text.official_en: Remember things about your home. So that’s why you challenged us to a fight.

text.jp:
ああ、その通りだ。
オレの記憶のカギは、やっぱり「橋」だ。
text.official_en: Exactly. Although, now I know that the key to restoring my memories is bridges.
text.real_en: Exactly. The key to my memories really must be a bridge.

text.jp: ああ、任せておけ！
text.official_en: You got it!

text.jp: ああ、手を貸してやろうぜ。
text.official_en: Right. I was thinking the same.
text.real_en: Yeah. Let's give him a hand.

text.jp:
ああ。
実はオレは……
text.official_en: Yes. You’re never gonna believe me in a million years, but, but I was...

text.jp: ぐ……お前はちょっと細かいぞ、ラスウェル。
text.official_en: Ugh... Is that why the hairs on your head are so long, Lasswell? So that you can split them all day? You worry too much about useless details.
text.real_en: Gah... You're a little too particular about things, Lasswell.

text.jp:
ここではない違う世界から
お前たちの世界に流れついたらしい。
text.official_en: I’ve been left stranded in this world. That’s right, I’m from a different world than yours.
text.real_en: It seems I drifted into your world from a different one.

text.jp:
この旅ではいろいろと
不思議なことに巡り合っているからな……。
text.official_en: We have encountered stranger occurrences in our recent travels.

text.jp:
この飛空艇から見下ろしながら
気になる橋に印をつけたんだ。
案内を頼むっ！
text.official_en: Yeah, I’ve picked out a few that caught my eye from the airship and marked them on the map. Lead the way!

text.jp: これは、あの時の……。
text.official_en: These are...those gloves from before.
text.real_en: These are... the gloves from before.

text.jp:
さて、橋を巡るんだったよな。
目星はついているのか？
text.official_en: Now then, we need to visit various bridges. Do you have an idea where we can begin?

text.jp: し、死ぬかと思ったぜ……。
text.official_en: I... I thought I was going to die...

text.jp: そういうものか。
text.official_en: You have, have you?

text.jp: そういえば、渡すものがあったぜ。
text.official_en: Here—there’s something I need to hand you.

text.jp:
そこで頼む！
オレを各地の橋に連れていってくれ！
たくさんの橋をめぐれば、もっと思い出せるはずだ！
text.official_en: I’m begging you! Take me to various bridges of this world! Perhaps if I see enough of them, my memories will come rushing back to me!

text.jp: それがラスウェルの良さだから。
text.official_en: Wouldn’t be Lasswell without him noticing the important little details.
text.real_en: That's one of Lasswell's good qualities.

text.jp: それは……「橋」だ。
text.official_en: It was of...a bridge.

text.jp:
たったそれだけの記憶だが、振り返れば心ふるえる
素晴らしき勝負だった……。
text.official_en: It is only the faintest whiff of the memory, but it is enough to remind me of how glorious a fight it was...
text.real_en: That's all I remember, but looking back, it was a magnificent fight that still makes my heart race...

text.jp: だからお前たちと、いい勝負をすれば……
text.official_en: I figured that if I fought a glorious battle with you, I’d...

text.jp:
でも、この世界を旅するうちに、
ある一つの景色の記憶が
ぼんやりと浮かんできた。
text.official_en: But after traveling this world...an image has slowly crept its way back into my mind.

text.jp:
どうやって、なんのために、どこから来たのか……
何も思い出せないまま、オレはさまよっていた。
text.official_en: I wandered this world devoid of how and why I came here...as well as from whence I came.
text.real_en: I wandered around without remembering where I'd come from, how I'd got here, or why.

text.jp:
まぁ、そういうことも
あるかもしれないと思ってさ。
text.official_en: You never know, anything’s possible.

text.jp: もとは盗品なんだがな……。
text.official_en: Although I would mention that they were stolen from us in the first place...
text.real_en: They were stolen from us to begin with, though...

text.jp:
オレは元の世界にいたとき、どこかの橋で戦った。
そんな思い出が、うっすらよみがえったんだ。
text.official_en: Yes, the image I have is of me fighting on a bridge in my original world.
text.real_en: I vaguely remember fighting on a bridge somewhere in my original world.

text.jp: レイン。
text.official_en: Rain, I’m for helping him out.

text.jp: 大丈夫か、ギルガメッシュ。
text.official_en: You all right, Gilgamesh?

text.jp: 意外と驚かないんだな。
text.official_en: You’re awfully quick to digest that big reveal.
text.real_en: You're not as surprised as I expected.

text.jp:
戦う前に
「確かめたいこと」があると言っていたな。
事情を聞かせてもらおうか。
text.official_en: You mentioned something about finding something out. Care to enlighten us?

text.jp:
故郷への手がかりをつかみたい。
お前の切実さは、伝わった。
text.official_en: That said, I see you’re being sincere about wanting to find clues for a way back home, Gilgamesh.

text.jp:
景色？
どんな景色なんだ？
text.official_en: Can you describe it?
text.real_en: An image? What did you see?

text.jp:
橋をめぐれば記憶が戻るというのか？
雲をつかむような話だが……
text.official_en: Will merely visiting bridges restore your memories? That sounds like an ambitious assumption.
text.real_en: You think visiting bridges will bring back your memories? That's a pretty long shot...

text.jp: 橋？
text.official_en: A bridge?

text.jp: 約束、守ってくれたな。
text.official_en: Heh. You did, and you kept your word.

text.jp:
約束したはずだぜ。
「強くなったら返す」ってな。
text.official_en: I promised that I would give them to you once you were stronger, did I not?

text.jp: 違う世界か……。
text.official_en: Oh. That explains a lot.
